integrity.method: exact analytic formulas plus independent-formula rational stage checks

scientific_limitations: Exact one-step phase law is for a unit-rate, five-state absorbing birth chain and continuous uniform tableau parameter, not arbitrary Markov generators.
Low-step negative ensemble-mean entry holds asymptotically; no statement about all step sizes.
General positivity and SSP theory may contain prior implicit analogues; publication priority is not independently established.
The exact-rational checker is finite verification, not an infinite or independent proof.
title: A reentrant Markov-positivity window for randomized SDIRK on five birth states
